integrity: The lattice cutoff is proved from the binary-form reduction inequality m^2 <= Delta, whose proof is reconstructed. The U(4) norm, pairing ideal, discriminant, and primitive embedding into U^3 are checked exactly. The degree-of-irrationality conclusion uses the complete 2026 polarization classification and a standard period-map existence theorem.
scientific_limitations: The sharp threshold is for Picard number two only. The existence proof is period-theoretic and produces a generic family with exact Neron-Severi lattice U(4), not an explicit projective equation. No higher-Picard-rank discriminant threshold is claimed.
title: Discriminant \(16\) is the first rank-two gap beyond Martin's obstruction
